## Human review

- [ ] Client approvals and DEV-only boundary confirmed
- [ ] Evidence reviewed, not just the agent's summary
- [ ] Required checks passed; exceptions have named approval
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, personal data or unapproved client content committed
- [ ] Product owner acceptance and reviewer decision recorded
- [ ] Release remains a separate human-approved step
